name: mfe-anatomia
description: Una app que enseña micro-frontends siendo ella misma un micro-frontend.

scripts.build: npm run figures && npm run build -w catalog -w details -w guide-ssg -w shell
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n shell,catalog,details,news,guide -c white,blue,cyan,yellow,green "npm run preview -w shell" "npm run preview -w catalog" "npm run preview -w details" "npm run start -w news-ssr" "npm run start -w guide-ssg"
scripts.dev: npm run build && concurrently -k -n shell,catalog,details,news,guide -c white,blue,cyan,yellow,green "npm run dev -w shell" "npm run preview -w catalog" "npm run preview -w details" "npm run start -w news-ssr" "npm run start -w guide-ssg"
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test
